It doesn't grant any special effects, but boy is it tasty!|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Endura Shrooms are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by burning [[Endura Shroom]]s with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} While they do not grant special effects, they are still considered to be delicious. When eaten, Toasty Endura Shrooms restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Endura Shrooms reappear in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by exposing [[Endura Shroom]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They are widely considered to be delicious, despite providing no additional effects. Eating a Toasty Endura Shroom will heal Link by one and a half Hearts. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Endura Shroom * Food * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
